claim_text: Hair loss and nail brittleness are nonspecific and may occur with selenium excess as well as in other conditions; these symptoms alone do not diagnose selenium deficiency.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting hair or nail changes.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Selenium fact sheet describes manifestations of deficiency and selenosis.
limitations: Do not recommend selenium without assessing total exposure and other causes.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
